'''''Nahosos''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to restore the Republic]]. The transport was present for the Rebel Summit in the [[Delfii system/Legends|Delfii system]] carrying [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].
